scope: Proposition 4.4 (Labelled attachments) of the manuscript “Thomason Model Structures in Every Strict Higher Dimension” (preprints/Thomason-Model-Structures-in-Every-Strict-Higher-Dimension-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 317 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4297861df49692b8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A ⊂ P be a full subposet, let a : UA → X be any strict functor, and form Y = X ⨿UA UP . Suppose a monotone map λ : P → [1] and a strict functor ξ : X → D1 satisfy ξa = U(λ|A) : UA −→ D1, U[1] = D1. Write Pϵ = λ−1(ϵ), Aϵ = A ∩ Pϵ, and Xϵ = ξ−1(ϵ). Then the induced label Y → D1 has actual full fibers Yϵ ∼ = Xϵ ⨿UAϵ UPϵ . (4.2) Moreover, independently of these labels, Ob Y ∼ = Ob X ⨿A P ∼ = Ob X ⨿ (P \ A). (4.3) For two such pairs of compatible labels, write λ̄1, λ̄2 : Y → D1 for the induced labels. Their 0- fibers intersect in the 0-fiber of max ◦(λ̄1, λ̄2); their 1-fibers intersect in the 1-fiber of min ◦(λ̄1, λ̄2). Formula (4.2), using the corresponding maximum or minimum on both original legs, computes these intersections as well.
